messages:
maya: Quick sync 1: We need a tight benchmark narrative for launch that ties latency to unit economics. Thinking 3 assets: launch post, two-chart visual (latency vs $ + throughput heatmap), and webinar. Suggestions on audience split and routing?

sam: Audience buckets: 1) Dev/ML engineers (PLG demos), 2) Infra/platform (ops + SLA buyers), 3) Enterprise procurement/security. Routing: enterprise leads -> AE, infra signals -> SDR+webinar, dev traffic -> self-serve drip.

jordan: Visuals should be minimal: Chart A = median p95 latency (ms) on x vs tokens-per-$ on y, with 3 model callouts. Chart B = throughput-per-GPU (seq/s) heatmap by model family vs cost tier. One-phrase headline each.

lia: Email flow idea: three sequences. Tech short: 1 email w/ code+perf snippet. Biz short: savings snapshot + CTA. Nurture: 4 touches including webinar invite at touch 2. Draft subjects: "Faster inference, lower unit cost", "How latency eats dollars", "Live: tradeoffs architects care about".

eli: HubSpot routing pseudo: 
```
if company_size >= 500 AND intent_score >= 75 -> assign = "AE-enterprise"
elif url_contains("/pricing") OR utm_campaign=="perf_econ_launch" -> enroll = "webinar_priority"
else -> enroll = "dev_drip_v1"
```
I'll add region/compliance flags.

hubspot-bot: Workflow created: perf_econ_launch_2026 (id: wf_2026_perf_econ).

sam: Social plan: 2 dev posts with a tiny code sample + perf numbers, 2 infra posts with SLA/econ pullouts, LinkedIn carousel with the two charts. CTAs: Try API, Register webinar, Book dedicated demo.

maya: Webinar runbook: 30m presentation (product + infra tradeoffs), 20m live Qs, 10m customer panel. Demos: 1) low-latency config using prefix caching, 2) cost-saver path using quantized fallback. Need a preflight checklist for demo reliability.

jordan: AB test idea on headline framing: Variant A = econ-first ("tokens -> $") Variant B = ops-first ("latency -> ops $") Track impressions, CTR, webinar signups over 2 weeks. I'll provide CSV template for analytics: variant, impressions, ctr, webinar_signups, demo_requests.

lia: I'll draft the three email sequences (deadline: Fri EOD). @sam can you produce the two slides as PNGs for email? @jordan please share the data table for charts + AB plan. @eli wire the HubSpot rules and confirm AE queue mapping.

sam: Slides first pass by Thu EOD. Will include alt text and export PNG/SVG.

maya: I'll draft the launch post tonight and put a 1-sentence TL;DR for social and a 2-line webinar subject. Quick ask: keep claims conservative and include methodology note for charts. :rocket:

eli: Added tracking tag: utm_source=perf_econ_launch to webinar links. Also will set conditional assignment for compliance=true -> add security_reviewer label.

jordan: Sample data table for the blog (tiny):
```
Model,Median_p95_ms,Tokens_per_$
redwood-8k,78,125000
redwood-16k,95,110000
quant-4bit,130,190000
```
Use this to render the scatter and heatmap.

maya: Perfect. Let's keep threads short for approvals. Follow-ups in the shared doc. Thanks team! :pray:
